written: 2026-10-29, after claude_genfill_v1_1_20261029 FAILED (H log2 CI [-0.130, +0.100]; one +1.56-stop overshoot), before any v2 data, training or output
author: Claude (Cowork session); approved by Ahmed ('do the recommendations')

data.sources_and_exclusions: as claude_genfill_v1_20261027 (commercial-clean only; every development, validation, holdout and fresh-grade scene excluded and asserted)
changes_from_v1: clip kinds: highlight 0.40, broad 0.25, shadow 0.15, random 0.20; 'broad' = exposure raised in half stops from -2 until >= 5 % of frame 0 is at code 255 (wide, mild clipping: the v1.1 overshoot case)
FXTD own footage: 2 clips per plate (was 1)
stored per clip: the core mask (max SDR code 255 or 0, every frame) and frame 0's true log2 AP1 luminance

loss: flow matching (shift 3) weighted 1 + 4 on the latent cells of the CORE (code 255/0), not the context mask

plus 0.5 x calibration at noise levels <= 0.6: the predicted clean latents of frame 0 decoded by the frozen float32 VAE; on frame 0's core pixels, (4 x relu(log2 Y_pred - log2 Y_true)^2 + relu(log2 Y_true - log2 Y_pred)^2): overshoot costs 4x undershoot
if the calibration runs out of GPU memory 3 times it is switched off; report.json says so and the run is then NOT this registration
training.transformer: loaded in bf16 keeping Wan's float32 modules (fixes the v1 cast warning)
training.optimiser: AdamW lr 1e-4, 200 warm-up, wd 0.01, clip 1, batch 1 x 4, float32 LoRA, seed 20261028
training.length: 4000 updates or 9.5 h (first 1000-update save after 9.5 h). THE LAST LoRA IS THE RESULT.

inference: blend only at max code 255 (shadows off), no feather, and a cap: the fill's luminance at most 3 stops over the master's (MaskSettings.max_gain_stops = 3); steps 30, seed 0, window 33, overlap 8

evaluation.scenes: Poly Haven: the shuffled held-scene list (seed 20261029) entries 48-71, none evaluated before; FXTD: the held FXTD scenes outside the fresh grade set (4 ELMATAREED scenes, pool 'extra'), none evaluated before
evaluation.clips: as v1.1: Poly Haven highlight + shadow clip per scene, FXTD highlight clip; exposure until >= 0.5 % of frame 0 at code 255 (highlight) / <= 4 (shadow)

gates: identical to claude_genfill_v1_1_20261029: R codes kept; H on code-255 pixels (log2 delta < 0 with the 95 % bootstrap CI excluding 0; PU21 at -3 and -6 EV lower); S on codes <= 4 at +3 EV (CI upper <= +2 %); T <= 0.02 EV; A <= 1.5
decision_rule: PASS: offer the AI fill (experimental, off by default) in the app and Radiance Studio. FAIL: stop and review the approach with Ahmed before any further training.
